description: Election Commission - Appointed Returning Officer and the Assistant Returning Officer to the Administrative District of Galle
reasoning: This gazette content specifically concerns the appointment of election officials (Returning Officer and Assistant Returning Officer) for the Elpitiya Pradeshiya Sabha in the Galle Administrative District under the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance.
